title: Dynophore-Based Approach in Virtual Screening: A Case of Human DNA Topoisomerase IIalpha.
authors: Janezic, Matej; Valjavec, Katja; Loboda, Kaja Bergant; Herlah, Barbara; Ogris, Iza; Kozorog, Mirijam; Podobnik, Marjetka; Grdadolnik, Simona Golic; Wolber, Gerhard; Perdih, Andrej
one_liner_zh: 该文以人DNA拓扑异构酶IIα为靶标，用MD模拟和dynophore药效团进行虚拟筛选与结合建模，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移，但非TF-DNA体系，故评5分。
abstract: In this study, we utilized human DNA topoisomerase IIalpha as a model target to outline a dynophore-based approach to catalytic inhibitor design. Based on MD simulations of a known catalytic inhibitor and the native ATP ligand analog, AMP-PNP, we derived a joint dynophore model that supplements the static structure-based-pharmacophore information with a dynamic component. Subsequently, derived pharmacophore models were employed in a virtual screening campaign of a library of natural compounds. Experimental evaluation identified flavonoid compounds with promising topoisomerase IIalpha catalytic inhibition and binding studies confirmed interaction with the ATPase domain. We constructed a binding model through docking and extensively investigated it with molecular dynamics MD simulations, essential dynamics, and MM-GBSA free energy calculations, thus reconnecting the new results to the initial dynophore-based screening model. We not only demonstrate a new design strategy that incorporates a dynamic component of molecular recognition, but also highlight new derivates in the established flavonoid class of topoisomerase II inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们以人类DNA拓扑异构酶IIα为模型靶标，概述了一种基于动态药效团（dynophore）的催化抑制剂设计方法。通过对已知催化抑制剂和天然ATP配体类似物AMP-PNP进行分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们推导出一个联合动态药效团模型，该模型在静态基于结构的药效团信息基础上补充了动态组分。随后，我们将推导出的药效团模型应用于天然化合物库的虚拟筛选活动中。实验评估鉴定出具有前景的拓扑异构酶IIα催化抑制活性的黄酮类化合物，结合研究确认了其与ATPase结构域的相互作用。我们通过对接构建了一个结合模型，并利用分子动力学模拟、本质动力学和MM-GBSA自由能计算对其进行了广泛研究，从而将新结果与初始基于动态药效团的筛选模型重新联系起来。我们不仅展示了一种纳入分子识别动态组分的新设计策略，还强调了已确立的黄酮类拓扑异构酶II抑制剂类别中的新衍生物。
